subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How Online Fraud Took Over
description: One-minute skill: How Online Fraud Took Over.

hook.text: In 2000, online fraud was a novelty. By 2024, it accounts for over half of all reported crime.

buildup.text: The internet removed geography from crime. A scammer in one country can target victims worldwide.

discovery.text: Low cost, high anonymity, and massive scale make online fraud more profitable than drug trafficking.

twist.text: Most online fraud is never reported. The real numbers are far worse than any statistic shows.

climax.text: Cybercrime has become the world's third-largest economy if measured as a country.

punchline.text: Crime found its perfect platform: the internet.

quiz.question: Why is online fraud more scalable than traditional crime?
options: It removes geography and costs almost nothing to scale
